text:
erin: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak the KV kernel routing changed defaults and we see per-route prefix reuse drop ~30% on checkout/cart. p95 token latency up. anyone digging?
marc: saw that this morning. KV prefix hit rate for /checkout fell from ~0.82 -> 0.55 in the 3–6am window. evictions spiked.
jia: alert fired for token-latency-regression at 03:14. I grabbed traces, looks like more time in 'kv_lookup' stage and more frequent kernel handoffs. short sequences most affected.
rob: can you paste the dashboard links/panels?
erin: panel: https://redwood.ops/dashboards/kv-cache?view=route-reuse and waterfall: https://redwood.ops/dashboards/latency?panel=token-waterfall
marc: quick PromQL I used: ```
sum by(route) (increase(kv_prefix_evictions_total[5m]))
(sum by(route) (increase(kv_prefix_hits_total[5m]))) / (sum by(route) (increase(kv_prefix_requests_total[5m])))
```
jia: also saw kernel-selector logs showing a change that prefers GPU-optimized kernels for mixed-length batches; that seems to degrade KV reuse because kernel packing changes chunk boundaries.
rob: hmm. did this ship via the auto-rollout yesterday? @infra-bot any deploy notes?
infra-bot: deploy-bot: kernel-selector-v2 rollout completed to canary -> prod at 2025-10-12T03:12:09Z (revision v2a). Changes: kernel heuristics + batcher packing tweak. :rocket:
erin: proposed mitigations: 1) rollback kernel-selector tweak for prod canary -> baseline 2) add a route-level override to force old kernel for short-seq heavy routes 3) tweak batcher to preserve prefix alignment for KV caching.
marc: I rolled the selector back in canary at 04:05 and restarted a few hosts. early signal: evictions down, hit-rate creeping back up.
jia: after rollback metrics look better — checkout reuse up ~+25% within 15m, p95 token-latency improved ~30ms. We'll keep the experimental variant off until we model prefix alignment cost.
erin: opening PERF ticket with repro steps, traces, and dashboard snapshots. I'll add alert rules: kv_prefix_hit_rate < 0.7 for top-20 routes and kv_prefix_evictions rate > 50/min.
rob: can we add a small telemetry card to the per-route Overview that shows 'reuse-by-route' + memory footprint (MB) and last-eviction-timestamp? would help fast triage.
jia: agree — adding panels: route_kv_reuse_ratio, kv_memory_bytes{route}, kv_last_eviction_timestamp. also will add a token-level breakdown showing time spent in kv_lookup vs kernel_exec vs postprocess.
marc: note for release/next-steps: before reintroducing the kernel selector changes we should run a routing simulation that preserves prefix boundaries and test with our synthetic route distribution (short-heavy + long-chat).
erin: assigning to @jia and @marc for follow-up. will post ticket ID once created. thanks all. :thumbsup:
